content.title: Explosion at Augsburg station – two injured, closure lifted
content.lead: Explosion at Augsburg station; large-scale police operation, train services suspended

content.text: ehj./jsc. A large-scale police operation was underway at Augsburg main station since shortly after 5 a.m. The reason was an explosion in a building passageway. According to the German Press Agency, two people were slightly injured. They reportedly suffered acoustic trauma.

According to initial information, an unknown object exploded in a building passageway opposite the station around 3:15 a.m. The injured included a 17-year-old and an 18-year-old. According to police, both were Ukrainians. Window panes were also damaged by the explosion, police said. Investigators assumed they were coincidentally in the area as passers-by.

After the discovery of another suspicious object, police completely cordoned off the main station at 8:30 a.m. and suspended train services. The German Press Agency, citing police, reported that the object proved harmless after police investigations, and the station closure was lifted after about an hour and a half.

content.text: The police operation also affected road traffic and public transport. At 10:15 a.m., police announced that train services had resumed.

+++ Update 10:15 Uhr +++

Unsere Einsatzkräfte vor Ort geben Entwarnung bei dem verdächtigen Gegenstand.

Der Hauptbahnhof ist wieder frei und der Zugverkehr läuft auch wieder.

Im ÖPNV kommt es weiterhin zu Einschränkungen. https://t.co/AdAwn8DO28

metadata.nzzSummaryEN:
- An explosion occurred in a building passage at Augsburg's main train station, slightly injuring several people. The cause remains unclear.
- Police operation caused disruptions in commuter and road traffic. Duration of closures is currently unknown.
- Windows were damaged; the extent of further structural damages is under investigation.
